correctness.rationale: Every commuting idempotent pair factors uniquely over the fibers of its product, each fiber rooted at its minimum. A necessary-and-sufficient classification uses disjoint noncommon fixed-point sets E,F; each unmarked point independently selects earlier parents from E and F. The resulting differential recurrence and labeled partition EGF are exact. A separate direct-exhaustive enumeration verifies all three-rank coefficients for 1<=n<=7; these finite tests are corroboration rather than proof.

value.rationale: Commutation among idempotents measures compatibility of retractions and is a natural invariant of the order-decreasing transformation monoid examined in 2024. The claim solves the complete three-rank enumeration in all finite degrees through an order-sensitive structural fiber theorem, not just a special finite case or a single Bell count. Its weights differ essentially from the exchangeable unrestricted full-transformation pair enumeration.
